s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain and constipation with a tender midline abdominal mass and history of amenorrhea
key_facts: Presenting with abdominal pain and constipation
Thyroid-stimulating hormone was undetectable 3 months earlier
Physical examination revealed a tender midline abdominal mass
Point-of-care urine hCG test was negative
Ultrasonography confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks

raw.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain and constipation with a tender midline abdominal mass and history of amenorrhea
key_facts: Presenting with abdominal pain and constipation
Thyroid-stimulating hormone was undetectable 3 months earlier
Physical examination revealed a tender midline abdominal mass
Point-of-care urine hCG test was negative
Ultrasonography confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks

shortlist.label: Intrauterine pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by ultrasonography at 24 weeks and high serum hCG level

shortlist.label: Molar pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of high serum hCG level and abdominal mass

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of tender midline abdominal mass

shortlist.label: Ovarian tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of abdominal mass and constipation

shortlist.label: Placenta accreta
shortlist.why_kept: Possible complication of intrauterine pregnancy given history of amenorrhea and abdominal mass

raw.rationale: Ultrasonography confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks, which explains the abdominal pain, constipation, and abdominal fullness, and is consistent with the high serum hCG level

rejected.label: Molar pregnancy
rejected.why: Typically presents with abnormally high hCG levels and ultrasonographic findings of a heterogeneous mass, not a live intrauterine pregnancy

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyoma
rejected.why: May cause abdominal pain and constipation, but would not explain the high serum hCG level or the live intrauterine pregnancy on ultrasonography

rejected.label: Ovarian tumor
rejected.why: Would not explain the live intrauterine pregnancy on ultrasonography or the high serum hCG level

rejected.label: Placenta accreta
rejected.why: Is a complication of pregnancy, but the ultrasonography findings do not suggest placenta accreta, and the presentation is more consistent with a normal intrauterine pregnancy
